name: skeleton
useFor: Use in the shape of what will load (rows of the email list, a table's rows, an avatar), matching each part's size and corners (rounded-pill for buttons, avatars and small icon tiles). It waits 300ms before it appears, so a quick load never flashes it.
constraints: Skeletons for content already on screen
A skeleton for a single button
source: Console Skeleton theme and its global skeleton delay
title: Skeleton
description: A lilac placeholder with 8px corners that breathes toward the lilac hover and shows only after 300ms.
